configurePresets.name: stub
configurePresets.description: Validates the repository scaffold without wxWidgets/OpenGL/Lua. Used by CI and for a quick sanity check.

configurePresets.name: pi-native
configurePresets.description: Native on-device build for the Pi 5. Uses the GLES backend and tunes for Cortex-A76. ELADS_STUB stays ON until feature code lands (Phase 1).

configurePresets.name: desktop-linux
configurePresets.description: x86-64 / arm64 desktop build. GLES backend by default; switch ELADS_RENDER_BACKEND=zink for GL-3.3-class parity on capable GPUs.

configurePresets.name: arm64-ci
configurePresets.description: Configure-only scaffold check on native arm64 GitHub Actions runners.

configurePresets.name: core
configurePresets.description: Builds the dependency-free core (util, archive, map model, render interface) and its CTest suite. Compiles on any C++17 toolchain — no wxWidgets/OpenGL needed.

configurePresets.name: desktop
configurePresets.description: Builds the core plus the desktop OpenGL backend, the headless renderer (elads-render), and the GL render test. Needs EGL + libepoxy dev packages.
